title: VIXEN variadic gatherers still validate their slots inside their own compile; make slot validation part of the intrinsic variadic lifecycle
body: op-vixennodehooks2 made the variadic data handling intrinsic to VariadicTypedNode (slot sources read at Compile and before Execute, no registered hooks). Validation is still per node: DescriptorResourceGathererNode and PushConstantGathererNode each call their own non-virtual ValidateVariadicInputsImpl(VariadicCompileContext&) mid-compile, after shader-reflection checks that need the compile context; ImageSync/BufferSync/PassGroup gatherers do not validate at all. Owner (R719 follow-up) wants validation intrinsic so it cannot be forgotten. Conversion: a virtual ValidateVariadicSlots(VariadicCompileContext&) step called by VariadicTypedNode::CompileImpl after the slot refresh and before VariadicCompileImpl, with the reflection-dependent part moved into the gatherers' overrides; then check the three non-validating gatherers' graphs still compile. Tier luna: several nodes plus their tests, ordering of reflection checks needs care.

title: GraphLifecycleHooks graph-phase registry has no production registrant after the per-node lifecycle refactor
body: After op-vixennodehooks2 removed the node half of GraphLifecycleHooks, the remaining graph-phase API (RegisterGraphHook, 6 GraphLifecyclePhase values, ExecuteGraphHooks at 6 RenderGraph.cpp sites) has zero callers outside test_node_lifecycle_events. The brief allowed graph-wide phases to stay, so it was kept. Either a consumer adopts it or it is deleted with its 6 call sites (deletion candidate; RenderGraph.cpp is shared with op-vixensubmit, so order after that lane). Also: tests/gpu-class-manifest.tsv still lists the 4 removed GraphLifecycleHooks.* cases until the next classify-tests-gpu.py pass rewrites it. Tier haiku: mechanical deletion, one test.
